Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street, all clear:

Walkthrough and sweep of the stairway next to the old AA Insurance headquarters along Albert Street, all clear.

Welfare check at People's Barista, Little Albert's Coffee, Barclay's Suites, Bespoke Coffee, Good To Go Supermarket, Natural Health Souvenirs, all clear.
Response call from Pop Mart requesting assistance in asking a male individual to move along from their store front; en route.
Arrived at the response call; asked the male individual to move along at the establishment's request, to which he complied.
Standing by until the individual moves along completely; he is under the influence of alcohol and marijuana and responding slowly.
Leaving standby and recommencing Echo Route.
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at Queens Arcade, all clear.
Ending Echo Route and commencing Beta Route.

Check-in at Gore Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Sal's Pizza, Goodlife, Romanis, all clear.
Welfare check and sweep through Wilson Carpark, Fort Street, all clear.
Response call from Cotton On management — three female individuals stole bikinis from the store, last seen heading up Queen Street.

Tracked the three females down and requested they surrender the items taken from Cotton On. They surrendered one item, claiming it was from the Albany store, and handed it over for staff to verify. Cotton On staff confirmed the item was theirs; a pink item may also have been concealed within their clothing, which the team cannot search for. Staff thanked the team. Returning to break.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Ops Phone charged at HQ due to low percentage before commencing patrols.
Arrived at the bottom of Durham Street East; welfare check:

All clear except Peter Alexander, who reported three young females attempting to remove tags from clothing before being deterred by staff — confirmed as the same three females who stole from Cotton On during the Morning Shift.
Continuing standby at the bottom of Durham Street East.
Leaving standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham Street; welfare check, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by to maintain security presence and on the lookout for any issues or vagrants:
Leaving standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.

Arrived at Pocket Park; welfare check, all clear, nothing to report. Maintaining presence at Pocket Park for nearby response calls and to ensure presence is known to the public and surrounding businesses:
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant smoking outside the premises, with the smell drifting into the store; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; informed the male vagrant he had to move along, and he complied. Standing by while he remains in the area in case he returns.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred and the male has not returned. Commencing patrols.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street; welfare check, all clear, nothing to report:
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by maintaining presence at TK Square for any issues or vagrants and ensuring presence is known to the public:
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at Lower Albert Street; welfare check at Aotea Gifts, Woolworths, Jade Centre, Sushi Pac, all clear.
Response call from Swarovski regarding a female busker who had just set up her speaker outside the store, making it difficult for staff to hear customers; assistance requested to move her along.
Arrived at Swarovski; politely asked the busker to move away from the store due to the noise complaints, and she complied. Standing by.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at Fort Street; welfare check, all clear, nothing reported. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any issues or vagrants:
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at Albert Street; welfare check at Haven Mart, all clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square; welfare check, all clear, nothing reported:
Full sweep of Chancery Square / Freyberg Square complete; welfare checks on stores at Chancery Square complete, no issues reported. Heading back to HQ for floor checks.

Response call from Chubby Boy regarding a male vagrant who stole the tip jar from the front counter. Attended; due to a language barrier staff could not provide a clear description of the person of interest and are awaiting footage from their manager. Standing by.
Footage received; on foot patrol looking for the person of interest. Staff informed that the stolen item will be returned if he is located.
Full sweep of Lorne Street and the Auckland Library area complete; no visual of the person of interest.
No visual of the male from Chubby Boy; the team will continue to look out for him while on patrol and upload him to Auror.
Arrived at HQ; commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed; standing by for a 10-minute break.
Standing by downstairs for the training guards.
AJ arrived; sent him and the team upstairs.
Heading out on patrol after the last guard was sent up; heading up Victoria Street.

Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal Streets. Welfare check on stores from Woolworths through to the 77 Convenience Store; high foot traffic and Police presence in the area. (Photo on file.) Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Elliott and Darby Streets; moved a vagrant along from the 77 Convenience Store. (Footage on file.) Elliott Street and Darby Street all clear; standing by.

At Elliott Stables, staff member Faye reported a male Uber Eats driver who came in blasting music and put hands on her. Awaiting footage; standing by for security presence and to issue a trespass notice.
Checking on surrounding businesses on Queen Street before heading back to the office for a food delivery.
All clear from Father Teds through to Localito; no issues. Standing by for security.
Standing by outside Noel Leeming due to its alarm going off.
Alarms went off; continuing to stand by for security presence.
Heading back to the office for a break.
All clear; Auror reports completed. Standing by for security presence and shift changeover.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
On standby at HQ charging the Ops Phone (14%) before patrols.
Ops Phone charged to 42%; heading out on patrol.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's, 77 Convenience Store and Avachi, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling upper Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Upper Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep and standing by for any nearby calls.
Aotea Square full sweep complete; on standby for any nearby calls.
No nearby calls; heading up Mayoral Drive towards Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at the 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street; a vagrant outside, on standby showing presence.
77 Convenience Store all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear, no issues.
Check-in at St Patrick's Cathedral, all clear, no issues; on standby outside Ace Karaoke.
Crowds arrived at Ace Karaoke; on standby showing presence.
Ace Karaoke all clear, no issues. Patrolling Albert Street.
Welfare check at the Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Albert Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report; Customs Street also appears clear at this time.
On standby outside Danny's showing presence.
Danny's all clear, no issues; welfare check with the marina guards, nothing to report from them.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Responded to a call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding an individual smoking inside the premises.
Arrived on site; all clear inside, but a group outside smoking — on standby showing presence.
The individual returned and went to sleep inside; removed him from the premises. A suspicious group remains inside; standing by.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear, no further issues. Heading back down Queen Street.
On standby at Imperial Lane for any nearby calls.
Lower Queen Street all clear, no issues and no calls; heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's on the way; vagrants inside cleared out as soon as they saw the team, no further issues.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute break.
Break ended; on standby at HQ ready to respond to any calls.
Night Shift concluded; handover to the Morning Shift.
